message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to empty your hand in each round. | | **Players** | 2–10 (standard deck works best with 4–8). | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (1–9, two of each 0, two of each action card) + 8 Wild cards (4 Wild, 4 Wild Draw 4). | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw 2,” the first player draws two cards and loses their turn). | | **Turn Order** | Clockwise (unless a “Reverse” card changes direction). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top discard. If you can’t play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; if challenged and found you had a playable card, you must draw 4 cards instead.) | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have **exactly one card left**, you must shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The first player to discard all their cards wins the round. | | **Scoring** | • Winner gets points equal to the sum of all cards left in opponents’ hands:
 – Number cards: face value.
 – Skip/Reverse/Draw Two: 20 points.
 – Wild/Wild Draw Four: 50 points.
• If the winner has no cards left (i.e., they just played their last card), they get a bonus 100 points. | | **Game End** | First player to reach the target score (usually 500) wins the game. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep track of the color** – If you’re holding many cards of a single color, try to play them early to avoid being stuck later. 2. **Use Wilds strategically** – Save a Wild Draw Four for when you’re about to be forced to draw many cards. 3. **Watch opponents** – If someone keeps drawing, they might be holding a lot of cards; consider playing a Skip or Reverse to stop them. 4. **Challenge wisely** – Only challenge a Wild Draw Four if you’re sure the opponent had a playable card; otherwise you’ll pay the penalty. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
